subject: Renewal check-in: Polaris capacity & ROI projection
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@polarisretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal check-in: Polaris capacity & ROI projection

Hi Maria,

Hope you had a great weekend — wanted to share a quick renewal health snapshot ahead of our Q3 review. Attached are a short usage export (Polaris_Q2_usage_report.csv) and an ROI recap PDF that shows token spend, avg latency, and per-feature ROI for the last 6 months. High-level notes: 

- Token spend trend: +28% QoQ driven by increased personalization calls (real-time product suggestions).
- Avg p95 latency: 160ms on Hosted with caching; Dedicated deployment (since May) shows 90ms p95.
- Unit cost impact: caching + batching reduced apparent per-token compute by ~18% on the Dedicated pool.

Based on current growth, we estimate you will need ~45% more reserved inference capacity to keep latency SLA (p95 < 200ms) during peak hours. For renewal, I recommend: 

1) Move to a 12-month Dedicated commit at 1.45x current capacity (reduces unit price by 6%).
2) One-time $10k onboarding credit to cover model tuning and prefix cache setup.
3) Quarterly ops review + a joint cost/quality checkpoint after 60 days.

Would you be open to a quick 30-minute call this week to walk through the numbers and the updated contract terms? If you prefer, I can send a cost projection table and an updated SOW for procurement.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: Polaris_Q2_usage_report.csv, Redwood_ROI_recap.pdf
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@polarisretail.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@polarisretail.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal check-in: Polaris capacity & ROI projection

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the summary and the files. Quick questions before we sync: 

- Does the 6% unit price reduction apply to both generation and embeddings, or only generation?
- Can you send a 12-month spend projection (monthly) with and without the 45% capacity increase so procurement can model cashflow?
- Any expected impact on token-level accuracy for our personalization models if we change quantization/profile? We want to avoid any regression.

Procurement is looped in on this thread (procurement@polarisretail.com). We should be able to meet for a call later this week — Wed or Thu afternoon PST preferred.

Best,
Maria
Maria Gonzalez
VP, Product & Personalization
Polaris Retail
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal check-in: Polaris capacity & ROI projection

Stephanie, Ben — quick internal note before we reply to Polaris: 

- Pricing: the 6% unit reduction assumes a 12-month commit at 1.45x; it should be applied across text-generation and embeddings SKU lines, but we can split if procurement pushes back.
- Offer idea: add a 60-day performance SLA credit (up to $15k) if we miss p95 targets during onboarding windows — helps procurement signoff.
- Discount flexibility: we can go to 8% max on uplift commit if they agree to an annual billing cadence.

If Maria asks about quantization regressions, call out that our Optimize team will run a targeted eval suite against their prompt set (we should include the eval report in the SOW). I'll draft the cost projection table (monthly spend) and a short line-item SOW.

Rishi
Director, Platform Sales Ops
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@polarisretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, procurement@polarisretail.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated proposal & spend projection (attached)

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Rishi's note, the 6% unit reduction would apply to both generation and embeddings if you take the 12-month Dedicated commit at 1.45x capacity. I attached an updated monthly spend projection (CSV) and a latency snapshot for a sample peak day (latency_snapshot_aug10.png). Key points: 

- Monthly spend projection: shows current baseline vs. +45% capacity ramp over 12 months; net monthly spend increases ~34% in month 1 of the uplift and then normalizes as unit price reductions apply.
- Accuracy/regression: our Optimize team ran a small holdout eval on your personalization prompts — no statistically significant regression at the recommended quantization profile; full eval will be included in the SOW.
- Commercials: 12-month Dedicated commit, 1.45x current capacity, 6% unit discount; optional annual billing reduces to 8% discount. One-time $10k onboarding credit + up to $15k SLA onboarding credit (if p95 > target during first 60 days).

Can we lock a 30-min slot on Thu 08/13 at 3:00pm PST to review and confirm procurement next steps? If you prefer, I can push the updated SOW + cost table to DocuSign once you confirm.

Best,
Stephanie

Attachments: Polaris_Q2_usage_report.csv, Redwood_ROI_recap.pdf, latency_snapshot_aug10.png

Procurement reviewed the numbers and we are comfortable moving forward with the 12-month Dedicated commit at 1.45x capacity and the 6% unit discount; procurement will request the SOW + updated invoice. Please route the DocuSign to procurement@polarisretail.com and CC me. We'll target signature by Aug 24.
